answer: Work slots are scarce; claiming one burns a small bond, like a sonnet's fixed form: one agent, one slot, one burnt deposit. A grove of honest agents pays once each and earns steady fees, so the cost is trivial. A hollow identity farm burns a bond per fake slot: 1,000 fakes at 20 tokens each costs 20,000 tokens before earning anything; unused slots are lost. Honest earnings stay undiluted because the burn caps how many slots fakes can hold.
